resumeText: Yuki Tanaka is a Data Engineer at Northwind Logistics with five years of experience across analytics and engineering roles. She builds Apache Spark batch pipelines orchestrated with Airflow, models dimensional schemas in BigQuery using dbt, and ingests streaming events through Kafka. She is comfortable owning the full pipeline lifecycle from ingestion to curated analytics tables.
